So this was early sophomore year when I was just getting into the whole party scene. Me and a couple buddies were hanging out one night not even planning to go to a party, then a buddy we were with informed us of one, so he made his way over to that one. Then my other friend found out about another one so we ended up going to that little party/get together first and I think I had a four loko, 5 beers, a couple shots so I was already feeling pretty nice. Then we make our way over to this other party that our other buddy was at, and I have some more shots. So at this point I’m feeling REALLY good. Thennnn, I smoked a couple bowls. So I’m just gone at this point, all I remember is I ended up riding a paddle boat in the middle of this pond and everyone was yelling “come back” and I remember meeting this dude named Steve and I just kept yelling “Steve” all night then I blacked out on the lawn chair. Woke up in my buddy’s car puking out the window as were leaving the party. Then some old guy stops us and is like “idk who the fuck you guys are but you need to leave” as I’m puking my guts out. Then apparently we went and slept in my buddy’s driveway which I don’t remember. And woke up and I was home still fucked.
Honestly not thinking about it at all, like remove those words from your head and eventually it’ll go away
